# VLLM 推理优化知识图谱

## LLM 推理工作流概览 【BV1WpMt66ELN P1 02:38】
```mermaid
flowchart TD
    A["Prompt (N tokens)"] --> B["Prefill Phase"]
    B --> C["Compute Attention (N×N)"]
    C --> D["Generate First Token"]
    D --> E["Decoding Loop"]
    E --> F["Compute Attention (N)"]
    F --> G["Generate Token"]
    G --> H["Append Token to Sequence"]
    H --> I["Check EOS"]
    I -->|EOS| J["Stop"]
    I -->|Not EOS| E
```

## Attention 计算复杂度与缓存机制 【BV1WpMt66ELN P1 16:24】【BV1WpMt66ELN P1 26:04】
```mermaid
flowchart TD
    A["Attention Layer"] --> B["Input Tokens"]
    B --> C["Compute Keys (K)"]
    B --> D["Compute Values (V)"]
    B --> E["Compute Queries (Q)"]
    C --> F["Prefill: Compute Q·Kᵀ for all pairs"]
    D --> F
    F --> G["Store K,V in KV Cache"]
    E --> H["Decoding Step: Compute Q for new token"]
    H --> I["Retrieve K,V from KV Cache"]
    I --> J["Compute Q·Kᵀ (O(N))"]
    J --> K["Generate Token"]
    K --> L["Update KV Cache with new K,V"]
```

## 吞吐量、计算成本与优化手段 【BV1WpMt66ELN P1 01:20】
```mermaid
flowchart TD
    A["Input Length N"] --> B["Compute Cost C (↑ with N)"]
    B --> C["Latency L (↑)"]
    C --> D["Throughput T (↓)"]
    D --> E["Optimization: KV Cache"]
    E --> F["Reduces per‑step cost to O(N)"]
    D --> G["Optimization: Batch Processing"]
    G --> H["Increases parallelism"]
    D --> I["Fixed Hardware Resources"]
    I --> J["Limits max throughput"]
    F --> K["Higher Throughput"]
    H --> K
    J --> K
```
